values.note: $23 per standard site in recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 rate tables (tent-only site $22); the Forest Service page (last updated June 2025) says $25. One RV with tow per site; most sites take one extra vehicle, charged a per-night fee at the campground. Overflow camping nearby also charges a fee.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234795/rates (2026-06-03 to 11-01 and 2027-06-03 to 10-31: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 23, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 22) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/trappers-lake-shepherds-rim-campground ('Single Site: $25 per night', 'Overflow camping is available (fees are charged)'; last updated June 6, 2025) + recreation.gov notice ('One RV with tow per single site ... Extra vehicle will be charged a per night fee and collected at the campground'), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234795 ('electrical hook-ups are not available') + campsite catalog for 234795 (all sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 15 campsites (14 standard, 1 tent-only) plus a management site; standard sites take 18-54 ft, half of them 26 ft or more; 8 pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/trappers-lake-shepherds-rim-campground ('has 15 sites') + campsite catalog for 234795 (14 STANDARD NONELECTRIC + 1 TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC reservable, 1 MANAGEMENT not; Max Vehicle Length 18-54; Driveway Entry 8 Pull-Through, 7 Back-In), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Bear-proof food lockers at every site and bear-proof trash bins; the RV dump station is elsewhere in the Trappers Lake complex.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234795 ('Guests also have access to vault toilets and drinking water', 'There is an RV dump station within the Trappers Lake complex', 'Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/trappers-lake-shepherds-rim-campground ('Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Every campsite is reservable on recreation.gov; booking closes 2 days before arrival. Bookings run June 3 - October 31 (2027 table; the 2026 season ended November 1). A reserved site must be occupied by 11 a.m. the day after arrival or it is released. 14 nights in a row, 14 in a month.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234795 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Each Month', reservationCutOff 2, minWeekendStay 0; notice 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date') + /rates (2027 Peak Season 2027-06-03 to 10-31) + availability (Oct 2026 sites Reserved/Available to 10-31, 'Closed' from 11-01; Jun 2027 'NYR' from 06-03), read 2026-10-26

note: Last campground on the right up the hill above the Trappers Lake outlet bridge, at 9,720 ft beside the Flat Tops Wilderness (Blanco RD, White River NF); trails to Trappers Lake and the wilderness. 50 mi from Meeker on Rio Blanco CR 8 and Trappers Lake Road (FSR 205). --Claude
summary: FS page, rec.gov facility, rates, availability and catalog: a family campground for tents/trailers/RVs, not a stock camp (no corrals or stock sites; certified weed-free hay rule only). Confirmed $23 (2026, 2027), no electric, 15 sites, 54-ft max. Added pull-throughs, vault toilets, drinking water, dump in the complex, 2-day cutoff, 14-night max, booking.season Jun 3 - Oct 31. Pin matches the FS coordinates and the per-site centroid (~15 m). Note: dropped the site-count/length and 'Reservable online' restatements and the vague 'near Trappers Lake'.
flags: Fee disagreement: the FS page (last updated June 6, 2025) says $25 a night; recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 rate tables say $23. Wrote rec.gov's $23.
Entry phone is empty. Blanco Ranger District (970) 878-4039 (fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/offices). recreation.gov lists the facility phone as 970-927-0107 and the concessionaire line (801) 226-3564.

Access road: no page describes the road surface. The route is 39 mi on Rio Blanco CR 8 then 10 mi on Trappers Lake Road #205, then across the bridge and up the hill to the campground; no 4WD, high-clearance or RV-length warning is given.
